axes.name: FLOW
axes.location_description: Top power panel, horizontal axis along the bottom of the top plot area; tick labels and title are not shown in this panel, but the axis appears aligned with the lower panel's FLOW axis.

axes.name: POWER
axes.location_description: Top power panel, left vertical axis labeled POWER with unit [hp]; used for Input power and Shaft power curves.

axes.name: FLOW
axes.location_description: Bottom main panel, bottom horizontal axis labeled FLOW with unit [l/s] at lower right.

axes.name: HEAD
axes.location_description: Bottom main panel, left vertical axis labeled HEAD with unit [m] near the upper left of the plot.

axes.name: NPSHR
axes.location_description: Bottom main panel, right-side inner vertical axis at the plot boundary, labeled NPSHR [m], with scale from about 0.0 to 15.0.

axes.name: EFF
axes.location_description: Bottom main panel, right-side outer vertical axis, labeled EFF [%], with percentage tick labels.

warnings: The top panel's x-axis has no visible tick labels or axis title; FLOW [l/s] is inferred from the aligned lower panel axis and shared chart context.
Two bottom-panel y-axes use metres as their unit, but they measure different quantities: HEAD and NPSHR. Both are retained as primary axes.
